h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tenali

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Tenali

c: Canals from the Krishna run through Tenali, and the town has a long tradition of theatre, music and schools. Parks along these canals and the many school grounds are where an open gym fits best. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Tenali, in Guntur district, making every machine at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 890 km away, and sending it by road. Our machines need no power supply and no trainer.

School managements here often want equipment that teachers, parents and older students can share. Our Fun Fitness machines suit that because they use body weight and need no adjustment between users. We plan the set, mark the clear space on a layout drawing, and install with our team or a dealer in south India after you approve.

items.q: Can school students use outdoor gym equipment?
items.a: Older students can, under the school's supervision. Our Fun Fitness machines are built for adult and teenage users, so keep them away from the play area for younger children.

items.q: Where should a school place its outdoor gym?
items.a: Near the gate or waiting area, so parents and staff can use it, and apart from the children's playground. We mark the location and clear space on the layout drawing.

items.q: Are the machines suited to humid weather?
items.a: Yes. The frames are galvanised and the seats and handles are roto-moulded. They resist rust in humid air when wiped down and maintained as we advise.
